mechanism: Methimazole may impair hepatic metabolism of fentanyl through CYP3A4 inhibition and agranulocytosis-related immune suppression, potentially increasing fentanyl levels and CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for signs of fentanyl toxicity (respiratory depression, excessive sedation); consider fentanyl dose reduction if methimazole therapy is initiated; ensure adequate hematologic monitoring during concurrent use.
